en: A sepia-toned street view shows a tree-lined avenue with tram tracks running along cobblestones, flanked by multi‑storey townhouses with shops at street level. In the distance rises a tall church with a pointed spire. People walk along the sidewalks and a tramcar approaches in the right lane. At the top of the image is the printed caption in German: "Meißen‑Triebischtal – Talstraße." Additional German shop signs are visible on the buildings.
